title: 第27章 万年梨花灵树
novel_title: 开局暴打渣男，我带九个道侣飞升
content_zh:
“你这只小狐狸，你掺和什么？我哪有什么危险？你知道一棵树修出灵识有多不容易吗？而且，像我这样有着万年树龄的，乃是灵树，这片大陆上可没几株！”梨花树见墨燃总是阻止这小丫头片子放它出来，急得它骂骂咧咧的。

    “你……”

    “行了，你们别吵了。”路仙瑶被吵得脑瓜子疼，对墨燃说道：“墨燃，我自有分寸，你不必担心。”

    “可是……”

    “我是你的主人，我的任何决定，无需争得你同意。”路仙瑶直接勒令他不要再干扰她的决定。

    墨燃愣了一下，虽然路仙瑶为了讨好云鹤珏，经常对他们几个炉鼎非打即骂的，但也因为自己在她面前表现得乖乖的，她从未对自己说这么重的话。

    她如今好似……变了个人…

    “好吧……”

    既然她执意要给这株梨花树解开封印，他没有再阻止。

    若是这株梨花树对她不测，他届时再将其摧毁即可。

    路仙瑶重新看向梨树，声音变得严肃，“你想让我放你出来也可以，但你需得认我为主，并且告诉我，红月上仙当年能改变体质，逆天改命的修炼功法宝典。”

    既然它是红月上仙豢养的灵树，必然知道红月上仙将功法宝典藏在哪了。

    “你这小丫头片子，看着年纪不大，心机却这么深沉？”梨花树听到她的要求，以为是自己听错了，声音里充满了不可置信：“你这筑基初期的修为，狗看了都嫌弃！想让我认你为主，还得到我主人修炼的功法宝典？你怎么不做梦呢？”

    它就知道，人族是何等卑鄙狡诈，又怎会愿放它出去？

    路仙瑶知道对方不会轻易答应，也不恼怒，“行吧，那你便在这等下一位有缘人来替你解开封印吧。”

    这个小院如此隐蔽，它估计是等不到咯。

    “你……”

    梨花树要被气炸了。

    这数万年来，能找到这的也就是四百年前那个王八蛋，还有这两个修为低微的修士，若是它能等到，就不会那么气了。

    但转念一想，这个空间秘境乃是主人心之所系，寻常人进来后，是出不去的，便也没有那么气了。

    “我出不去，你们也出不去，大不了就在这耗着！”

    “是吗？苍山内灵气浓郁，那我刚好可以借助苍山的灵气修炼，待我修炼至一定境界后，直接破境而出，你……可就未必了。”路仙瑶微笑地走到院中一旁的石桌前的石凳上坐下，整理了一下裙摆，闭眼，作势便要进入识海修炼。

    这可把梨花树给急坏了！
content_en:
"You little fox, what are you mixing in? How can I be in any danger? Do you know how difficult it is for a tree to cultivate spiritual consciousness? Moreover, a tree like me that is ten thousand years old is a spiritual tree, and there are not many in this continent!" The pear tree always stopped the little girl from letting it out when it saw the ink burning, so anxious that it cursed.

    "You..."

    "Okay, stop arguing." Lu Xianyao was so noisy that her head hurt, and she said to Mo Ran: "Mo Ran, I have my own rules, you don't have to worry."

    "But..."

    "I am your master, and there is no need to obtain your consent for any of my decisions." Lu Xianyao directly ordered him not to interfere with her decisions anymore.

    Mo Ran was stunned for a moment. Although Lu Xianyao often hit or scolded several of their furnaces in order to please Yun Hejue, but also because she behaved obediently in front of her, she had never said such harsh words to herself.

    She seems to be...a different person now...

    "Okay..."

    Since she was determined to unseal the pear tree, he did not stop her.

    If something unexpected happens to this pear tree, he can just destroy it when the time comes.

    Lu Xianyao looked at the pear tree again, and his voice became serious, "You can let me out if you want, but you must recognize me as your master, and tell me the magic book of the Hongyue Shangxian that can change your physique and change your destiny against the sky."

    Since it is a spiritual tree raised by the Immortal of the Red Moon, it must know where the Immortal of the Red Moon has hidden the magic treasure.

    "You are a little girl, you look young, but you are so scheming?" When Lihuashu heard her request, he thought he had heard it wrong, and his voice was full of disbelief: "Your cultivation in the early stage of foundation building is disgusting to dogs! Do you want me to recognize you as my master, and also get the book of exercises practiced by my master? Why don't you dream?"

    It knows how despicable and cunning the human race is, so how could it be willing to let it out?

    Lu Xianyao knew that the other party would not agree easily and was not angry, "Okay, then you can wait here for the next person who is destined to break the seal for you."

    This small courtyard is so hidden, it probably won't wait.

    "You..."

    The pear blossom tree is about to explode.

    In the past tens of thousands of years, the only ones who could find this place were the bastard four hundred years ago and these two low-level monks. If they could wait, they wouldn't be so angry.

    But then I thought about it, this secret space is where the owner's heart is. After ordinary people come in, they can't get out, so they are not so angry.

    "I can't get out, and you can't get out either. At worst, you'll just be wasting your time here!"

    "Really? The spiritual energy in Cangshan Mountain is rich, so I can just use the spiritual energy of Cangshan Mountain to practice. After I practice to a certain level, I will break out directly. You... may not." Lu Xianyao smiled and walked to the stone table beside the courtyard and sat down on the stone bench. She straightened her skirt, closed her eyes, and prepared to enter the sea of consciousness to practice.

    This made the pear tree anxious!
title_en: Chapter 27 Ten Thousand Years Pear Blossom Spiritual Tree
